Black Friday is historically one of the best times to stock up on the year's biggest gaming releases, and this year is no exception. Walmart has added a slew of new games to its Black Friday sale, including the recently released Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced. It's down to $30 - the lowest price since it launched in July.

That's only available on the PS5 version as part of Walmart's doorbuster Black Friday sale from Nov. 23-29, while the Xbox version is a little more expensive, but still on sale, at $44.99 across all other retailers.

Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced for $30

Ask just about anyone which Assassin's Creed game is their favorite in the nearly two-decade-long series and odds are Black Flag will come up frequently, despite being 13 years old and quite dated by contemporary gaming standards.

Thankfully, Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced brings the pirate-themed tale into the modern era, rebuilt from the ground up with improved visuals and lighting, reworked land and sea combat systems, expanded story and cutscenes, and some much-needed quality of life features.

We gave it a 9 in our review, saying it's "more than just the game you remember but shinier and better looking, it’s also an attempt to bring Black Flag’s systems and sensibilities up to today’s standards. Both land and sea combat are bolstered by new tricks that add depth and clarity to all of the action, the top-tier story of the Kenway patriarch proves it’s beloved for a reason..."

Digital Versions Are Also on Sale

If you prefer to purchase your games digitally, both the PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store have the game priced at $44.99 as part of each respective Black Friday sale. PlayStation's sale runs through November 30, while you can save on Xbox games through December 3.

Check out the full PlayStation Black Friday sale and Xbox Black Friday sale for even more savings.

And for even more great games down to all-time low prices at Walmart, check out the links just below to save on Resident Evil Requiem, Donkey Kong Bananza, and more.
